asks: When a program sends many held requests at once, how many asks do you get?
answer: One for the burst. The requests of one computer to one host that a rule holds while an ask about that host is open join it. The ask lists every request it would let pass, and your yes lets pass only those. A request that a program sends again after its own timeout joins the ask of the request it repeats, when the boundary can tell it is the same one: the same request id from the AWS SDK, or the same method, path and body. A request that arrives after you answered starts a new ask.
